10763: function weatherCodeToPresentation(code, isDay) {
10764:   const daytime = isDay !== 0;
10765: 
10766:   if (code === 0) return { emoji: daytime ? '☀️' : '🌙', label: 'Clear' };
10767:   if (code === 1 || code === 2) return { emoji: daytime ? '🌤️' : '☁️', label: 'Partly cloudy' };
10768:   if (code === 3) return { emoji: '☁️', label: 'Cloudy' };
10769:   if (code === 45 || code === 48) return { emoji: '🌫️', label: 'Hazy' };
10770:   if ([51,53,55,56,57].indexOf(code) !== -1) return { emoji: '🌦️', label: 'Drizzle' };
10771:   if ([61,63,65,66,67,80,81,82].indexOf(code) !== -1) return { emoji: '🌧️', label: 'Rain' };
10772:   if ([95,96,99].indexOf(code) !== -1) return { emoji: '⛈️', label: 'Thunderstorm' };
10773: 
10774:   return { emoji: '🌡️', label: 'Weather' };
10775: }

25558: (function initRotasticPullToRefresh(){

25607:

25609:     else if (atBottom()) mode = 'up';
